title: Consolidated Financial Statements, Year ended March 31, 2024 (note 1(o)(i) Tangible capital assets)
notes: Found by web search on 2026-10-22; PDF opened. Audited consolidated financial statements, not a stand-alone policy; the accounting-policy note 1(o)(i) gives the amortization lives. Buildings: Structure and electrical 40; Mechanical, roof, exterior architecture, and site work 20; Interior architecture 15. Also Land improvements: Bridges, docks, seawalls, and wharves 50; Roads and infrastructure: Road beds 40, Road surfaces 5 - 20, Infrastructure 20 - 30, Bridges 75; Ferries 2 - 30.

title: MODL Policy 047 Tangible Capital Assets Policy
notes: Found by web search and site crawl on 2026-10-22; PDF opened. Effective/adopted February 12, 2013 (p1, clerk's annotation p11). Useful-life table on p2, introduced as "The TCA committee of the Service Nova Scotia has suggested the useful lives provided in the table below. These guidelines are to be used both provincially and municipally". Building rows are whole-class only: Municipal buildings 40; Building - Plant (includes integral component e.g. equipment or fixture that is fixed and part of the structure) 20-25. No building-component rows; transcribed rows are the infrastructure classes. Shared template: the Guysborough (H-21, 2010) and Barrington (Policy No. 63, 2010) policies use the same Service Nova Scotia class list; Barrington's infrastructure values are identical to MODL's, Guysborough uses single values (25/25/20).

title: Policy H-21 Tangible Capital Assets Policy
notes: Found by web search and site crawl on 2026-10-22; PDF opened. Approval date March 10, 2010 (p1). Asset classes on p2, useful lives on p3, read from the text layer. Building rows are whole-class only: Municipal Buildings 40; Building plants 20; Operating plants 20. Same asset classes as the table MODL Policy 047 attributes to the Service Nova Scotia TCA committee ("These guidelines are to be used both provincially and municipally"); Guysborough uses single values (Street, roads and curbs 25; Traffic and Street Lights 25; Sidewalks 20) where MODL and Barrington give ranges; Sewer Lines 50, Lagoons 50 and Wharves 25 match.

title: Policy No. 63 Tangible Capital Assets Policy
notes: Found by site crawl on 2026-10-22; PDF opened. Notice to Council April 12, 2010; passed April 26, 2010 (p7). Appendix "B" useful lives on p5, read from the text layer. Building rows are whole-class only: Municipal Buildings 40; Buildings - Plants 20 - 25. Same asset classes as the table MODL Policy 047 attributes to the Service Nova Scotia TCA committee ("These guidelines are to be used both provincially and municipally"); infrastructure values identical to MODL Policy 047 (Streets, Roads & Curbs 25 - 30; Traffic & Street Lights 25 - 30; Sidewalks 20 - 25; Sewer Lines 50; Lagoons 50; Wharves 25), plus Ferries 30.
